Container.Name: Bootimus
Container.Overview: Modern PXE and HTTP boot server with embedded iPXE bootloaders, SQLite support and a web administration interface. It includes distributions, diagnostics, per-client access control, authentication, hardware inventory and boot logs.
Container.Requires: PXE clients must reach UDP 69 and TCP 8080. Configure DHCP option 66/67 or your router's network-boot settings for the Unraid host.

Config.Name: Admin UI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the Bootimus admin interface.

Config.Name: HTTP Boot Port
Config.Description: Host port for iPXE menus, kernels and initrds.

Config.Name: TFTP Port
Config.Description: UDP port for initial PXE boot.

Config.Name: Data Volume
Config.Description: Persistent data directory for ISOs, database, bootloaders and configuration.

Config.Name: BOOTIMUS_SERVER_ADDR
Config.Description: Unraid IP address announced to PXE clients. Set this explicitly unless automatic detection works.

Config.Name: BOOTIMUS_TFTP_PORT
Config.Description: Internal TFTP port; keep aligned with the container port.

Config.Name: BOOTIMUS_HTTP_PORT
Config.Description: Internal HTTP boot port; keep aligned with the container port.

Config.Name: BOOTIMUS_ADMIN_PORT
Config.Description: Internal admin port; keep aligned with the container port.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Container timezone, for example Europe/Berlin or UTC.
